title: DER INTEGER represents a positive number that may have a leading 00
summary: ASN.1 INTEGER uses signed two’s complement. A positive integer whose most significant bit is 1 needs a leading zero byte.
applies: Byte representation and parameter explanation of cryptography questions
detail: The INTEGER content of the positive number 128 is 00 80; after removing 00, 80 is used as a one-byte INTEGER to represent a negative number.
boundary: This is the content encoding of the type, and the first byte 00 cannot be regarded as the actual extra significant digits of the integer.
relevance: Check why the public key parameter differs by one byte from the original unsigned integer dump.
